up: Show all exact activity measurements obtained from assay CHEMBL4649966. By exact measurements I mean those where the standard_relation equals '=' and the standard_value is not null. For each such record, provide the ChEMBL identifier of the tested molecule (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), and the activity details: standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Do not restrict the number of rows returned or add any other filters.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649966'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
